name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_finished
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::OnDownloadFinished reports finished status and marks the standalone download dialog as successful.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wider download event-sink vtable is still under reconstruction; this target verifies the callback body directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442660 validates a stdcall callback that calls WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::SetStatusTextFmt("Finished!"), stores 1 to g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadDialogResult, returns S_OK in eax, and pops one stack argument.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_finished_smoke patches USER32 SetDlgItemTextA through the real SetStatusTextFmt path and verifies the finished text, progress HWND, control id 1023, global status buffer pointer, dialog result 1, and S_OK return.
